Applicant James Earl Smith said he could not speak to how the developers of the Pole Canyon project would feel about the contingency and felt the developer was gracious to allow them to build houses on their family farm. The Council explained to applicant their concern about density transfer resulting from construction two homes on thirteen acres ofproperty.
